adopters.body1: This isn’t a trading terminal. It’s a low-barrier way to back a grow you can actually watch: care logs, stage changes, and checkable updates tied to one plant’s life. Listed plants already have a two-week care trail — not a same-day mint.
adopters.body2: If you’re curious about real-world assets (RWAs: tokens tied to something physical, here a plant) and want something tangible — not another fund wrapper — start with the evidence trail. Test-network assets have no monetary value; use them to learn the trust flow before real stakes exist.

faq.a1: No. The journal, coach, and reminders are free and work with no wallet at all. A Solana wallet (Phantom or Solflare) is only needed if you want to mint or adopt on the test network.
faq.a2: No. growtoo is for cannabis growers (a plant or a few, or a full room), including places where cultivation rules are opening up. Always follow the law where you grow; growtoo is a documentation tool, not legal advice.
faq.a3: Today, the platform operator reviews journal progress before minting. Market listing is a separate gate: 14 days since the first watering or feeding log was saved, with care on at least half those days — backdated dates do not count. That is process evidence, not proof a physical plant exists. The live-network roadmap moves this toward stronger attestations so no single party has to be trusted forever. Details live in the trust model docs.
faq.a4: Redemption converts a harvest-stage token into its real-world counterpart, subject to applicable regulation in the grower’s jurisdiction. Today redemption is specified but still mocked on the test network, not a live fulfillment pipeline. Read Risks & scope for the honest limits.
faq.a5: So the system (journal proof, minting, escrow, redemption) can be battle-tested in the open first. Growers and adopters can see exactly how it works before anything real is at stake. “Devnet” is Solana’s public test network — same tools, no real value.
faq.a6: No. It’s a test-network token with no monetary value. It exists so the optional mint → verify → adopt flow can be tested publicly before real value is on the line.
faq.a7: Test-network $GROWTOO is for practicing the flow and should not be treated as transferable monetary balance. Early-grower recognition (the Founding Grower badge) is intended to carry forward; exact migration rules will be published before launch.
faq.a8: Targeting after the harvest redemption flow ships (roadmap milestone M5 in the docs). See the architecture notes in our docs. We publish milestones, not a vague “soon.”
faq.a9: You can seal a stage when the journal is ready. Posting to Market needs 14 days since the first watering or feeding log was saved, with care on at least half those days. Same-day mint-and-list is blocked. Backdated journal dates do not count. This is process evidence, not proof a physical plant exists.

proof.lead: The journal keeps the run findable. Minting a checkable trail is optional. Listing on Market waits for a two-week care trail.
proof.step1Body: The journal holds watering, feeding, stages, and photos as they happen — with reminders and a coach that reads the same log, so week nine still has week two.
proof.step2Body: Optional: mint each completed stage (germination through harvest) as an on-chain update linked to the journal entry. Every mint has a transaction anyone can check.
proof.step3Body: Your care log stays with the plant. Market listing needs 14 days since the first watering or feeding log, with care on at least half those days. Then others can follow that same trail.
proof.title: Log it. Prove it. Keep going.
